background_story: Pookie was a curious and agile cat with a passion for movement. Her owner, a professional dancer, would often come home from rehearsals and practice her choreography in the living room. Pookie would watch with fascination, her tail twitching in time with the music. One day, the dancer decided to teach Pookie the basics of Labanotation, a system of movement notation. To everyone's surprise, Pookie picked it up quickly, learning to read and write the intricate symbols that represented different movements. As the dancer worked on new pieces, Pookie would sit by her side, 'helping' to notate the choreography. Together, they created a unique feline-human collaboration, with Pookie's Labanotation skills adding a new dimension to the dancer's work.
